name: Back to Darnassus
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The time has come for us to part ways, young one, as the application of your lessons takes you back to whom that sent you to me.  Mathrengyl Bearwalker walks truly in balance with nature, even as he dwells precariously close to where the balance has faltered.  Listen to his instructions, and you will soon complete your first lessons into your role as a protector of balance.

Go now, young one.  We shall meet again.
narrative.objectives: Return to Darnassus and speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Welcome back, adventurer. I sense that your first meeting with the Great Bear Spirit is the same as it is with all druids when they first start down the path of the Claw... a little bewildering, but very intense. I know it was that way with me.

The Great Bear Spirit has been a part of Azeroth as long as Azeroth has existed in the heavens. We have come to rely on its wisdom and its power to fuel our purpose. Now, the time has now come for your first test of this purpose. Listen closely...

chain.subtitle: 7 quests at level 10, 1,650 XP in all.

quests.name: Moonglade
quests.objectiveText: Use the spell "Teleport: Moonglade" to travel to Moonglade.

quests.name: Great Bear Spirit
quests.objectiveText: Seek out the Great Bear Spirit in northwestern Moonglade and learn what it has to share with you about the nature of the bear.

quests.name: Back to Darnassus
quests.objectiveText: Return to Darnassus and speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave.

quests.name: Body and Heart
quests.objectiveText: Use the Cenarion Moondust on the Moonkin Stone of Auberdine to bring forth Lunaclaw.
